title: Unit 408 living: three directions (A, B, C)
overview: Three living directions for Unit 408, each with its own seating layout, so Ivan chooses a design rather than a plan: A Linen Daylight (a classic 3 + 1 + 1 in ivory fabric, woven linen chairs and light oak), B Teal and Ochre (a teal sofa with an ottoman chaise, an ochre tub chair, walnut and a cream-and-denim rug) and C Charcoal and Brass (two charcoal 2-seaters in an L with brass, marble and glass). Fixed in all three: the honey-amber parquet, Davies Beige blackout and voile curtains full length on both windows, the existing window AC with its front kept clear, the ceiling fan, and a 75 in TV on an 1800 x 400 console on the TV wall. Nothing in the living is site-measured yet: the room file carries assumed heights and positions (ASSUMED.md) and every plan is a conditional fit on them.
requirements: All prices assume new purchases. Three distinct sets of visible furniture, lighting, rugs, textiles and decor; no model or family repeats across the schemes or the parallel sets.
Every piece fits the measured room with clear walkways and door swings; plans use published dimensions and flag the rest.
Seating, tables and storage are real catalogue products with a supplier photo, price and source link.
procurement_gates: Prices are catalogue references with each line's own price date. Product existence and photos are verified; exact Cebu stock, address delivery and checkout totals are not.
Pieces flagged "dims unpublished" in the room placement report keep the layout size; measure them at the showroom before ordering.
Delivery path for the sofa, dining table and buffet (lift, corridor, door widths) to be confirmed with the building before ordering.
Style renders are AI interpretations painted over the dimension-led model views; supplier photo boards, measured plans and the item schedule are the acceptance basis.

schemes.title: Linen Daylight
schemes.rationale: ivory linen-look seating and cane in a daylight room, pale timber, one soft green: a classic 3 + 1 + 1 around a rectangular table
fit_notes: Seating option A: 3-seater along the south window facing the TV, two woven armchairs along the east window south of the window AC with a side table between them, rug 3400 x 2400 under the group.
Curtain lines kept: 250 mm behind the sofa and the chairs at both windows; the floor in front of the window AC stays clear.
Conditional fit: the living is not site-measured; ceiling, sills, heads, door heights and the fan and AC positions are assumed (see ASSUMED.md) and every plan and view depends on them until taped.

schemes.title: Teal and Ochre
schemes.rationale: a teal sofa with an ottoman chaise, one ochre tub chair, walnut and a cream-and-denim rug under a copper arc lamp: a warm evening room without the usual browns
fit_notes: Seating option B: 3-seater along the south window with the ottoman at its east end as the chaise, round walnut coffee table in front of its west half, one tub armchair by the east window south of the window AC.
The ottoman and sofa are two SKUs, so the layout engine places both; together they read as a sectional with a chaise.
Conditional fit: the living is not site-measured; ceiling, sills, heads, door heights and the fan and AC positions are assumed (see ASSUMED.md) and every plan and view depends on them until taped.

schemes.title: Charcoal and Brass
schemes.rationale: two charcoal 2-seaters in an L, brass as the single metal, marble and glass on ivory-grey, art on the notch wall
fit_notes: Seating option C: one 2-seater along the south window, one along the east window south of the window AC, corner table in the south-east corner, lounge chair on the TV-wall side of the rug.
The lounge chair stays 1000 mm off the TV console front so the bay-to-arch walkway holds.
Conditional fit: the living is not site-measured; ceiling, sills, heads, door heights and the fan and AC positions are assumed (see ASSUMED.md) and every plan and view depends on them until taped.
